answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 163856 Country: India Title: How many times in a year it is mandatory to complete the Holy Quran? Question: How many times in a year it is mandatory to complete the Holy Quran? Answer ID: 163856 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1447/1255/L=11/1439) It is better that the whole Quran is recited in one week or at least in forty days. وندب لحافظ القرآن أن يختم في كل أربعين يوما حزب وثلثا حزب أو أقل . (الهنديه: 5/317) Hadhrat Shaikh Zakariya has written in Fazail Amal with reference to Imam Abu Hanifah (may Allah have mercy upon him) that it is the right of the Holy Quran that it is completed twice in a year. (Fazail Amal: 14) Thus one should try to complete Quran at least twice a year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
